result.label: bug
result.what_to_change: parseStatement only pops a single trailing empty string produced by a final newline; when the file has an actual blank line after the last transaction (an extra blank line, not just the terminating newline), that blank line remains in `lines` and fails assertShape as a short row. The loop/line-splitting logic should skip or trim all trailing blank lines (e.g. loop while the last line is empty, or filter blank lines before parsing) rather than popping only one.
result.evidence: parser.ts does `if (lines.length > 0 && lines[lines.length - 1] === "") lines.pop();` which removes only the artifact of the terminating newline; a genuine blank line before EOF leaves one empty entry in `lines` that later fails `assertShape` with errors.rowShape, matching the reported 'Malformed row' error at the row just past the last transaction.

not_searched: src/ingest/schema.ts and other ingest files, not needed since parser.ts clearly explains the bug

input.title: Fix parseStatement to skip all trailing blank lines, not just one
input.body:
File: src/ingest/parser.ts

parseStatement currently pops only a single trailing empty string from `lines`, which handles the final newline artifact but leaves a genuine blank line before EOF in place, causing it to fail assertShape as a malformed short row. Update the logic to skip or trim all trailing blank lines (e.g. loop while the last line is empty, or filter blank lines before parsing) instead of popping just one.
